scope.description: Independent QA evaluation of 6 new delivered packages: 3 frontal grip cycles and 9 rear body keys (Orc V1)

bodySpecialist.description: 9 rear body keys across 3 clips (back_r/Sword, back_l/Sword, back_l/Axe), 3 keys each, strictly unarmed body

gripSpecialist.description: 3 complete frontal grip cycles (front_l/Sword, front_r/Axe, front_l/Axe), equipped with genuine tracked gloves

temporalPerception.notes: Direct visual inspection executed via multimodal image decoding on all native strips, composite strips, individual frames, and 8x diagnostic zoom tiles. Real-time continuous 1x motion in engine/browser was not observed in live playback; frame-by-frame and tactical static steps confirmed no blocking visual defects.

anatomicalEvaluation.activeArmKinetics: Authentic draw and diagonal lateral slash arc; shoulder, elbow, and wrist articulated cleanly across keys
anatomicalEvaluation.inactiveArmAuthenticity: Left arm acts as dynamic stabilizer, flexing naturally between poses without frozen copy-paste
anatomicalEvaluation.impactHandSeparation: Key 03 right glove (leather/brown) is distinctly defined against hip and tasset plate; no BODY-01 fusion defect
anatomicalEvaluation.rearConstruction: Clean occipital skull, neck collar, spine plate line, rear belts, no facial leaks

body-specialist/back_r-Sword-keys.safeSuggestions: In the intermediate authoring stage, ensure smooth downward diagonal trajectory interpolation of the right hand between apex (02) and follow-through (03) without abrupt angular snaps.

anatomicalEvaluation.dominantHand: RIGHT (screen right in back_l view; character turned northwest with back turned to camera)
anatomicalEvaluation.activeArmKinetics: Right arm raises near collar/ear in hoist (01), extends downward into slash in apex (02), finishes at right hip in impact (03)
anatomicalEvaluation.inactiveArmAuthenticity: Left arm extends downward-forward as counterbalance, authentic spiked pauldron and gauntlet
anatomicalEvaluation.rearConstruction: Vertebral column ridge, neck protection, tassets, clean occipital skull

body-specialist/back_l-Sword-keys.safeSuggestions: Maintain forearm angle alignment when authoring intermediates to preserve clean blade arc across the northwest quadrant.

anatomicalEvaluation.negativeSpaceCavity: The triangular cavity in Key 02 between skull, neck, and arched right arm is 100% transparent (0 residual grey pixels; surgical Aseprite fix verified)
anatomicalEvaluation.heavyImpactDelivery: Key 03 demonstrates authentic heavy axe physics: head drops forward, upper torso compresses downward, knees bend deeper, and hips absorb impact
anatomicalEvaluation.rearConstruction: Solid dorsal armor, vertebral ridge, occipital skull, authentic gauntlets

body-specialist/back_l-Axe-keys.safeSuggestions: When creating in-between frames for the downward smash, use rapid temporal spacing (fewer frames at the top, solid landing frame) to preserve the sensation of crushing downward momentum.

gripAndVisualEvaluation.gloveOcclusion: Hilt passes cleanly under authentic leather glove; fingers wrap naturally around the grip across all visible frames
gripAndVisualEvaluation.palmWristContinuity: handFront layer connects smoothly to wrist and forearm without floating stamp artifacts
gripAndVisualEvaluation.weaponVisibility: Sword appears only during active attack interval [2..10]; strictly hidden during prep and recovery
gripAndVisualEvaluation.tacticalReadability: Silhouette remains sharp and readable at 64px scale without pixel mushing

grip-specialist/front_l-Sword-full.safeSuggestions: Ready for candidate matrix patch assembly. Final confirmation of 1x fluid motion deferred to creator evaluation in interactive player / Unity.

gripAndVisualEvaluation.gloveOcclusion: Haft passes under glove; authentic leather fingers encircle the wood haft; axe head securely seated above fist in apex (F04)
gripAndVisualEvaluation.palmWristContinuity: Continuous connection from forearm to wrist and glove in impact frame F06 and recovery frames
gripAndVisualEvaluation.weaponVisibility: Axe strictly hidden during rest (F00), preparation (F01), and recovery (F09-F11)
gripAndVisualEvaluation.tacticalReadability: Axe blade profile and silhouette clear at 64px

grip-specialist/front_r-Axe-full.safeSuggestions: Ready for candidate matrix patch assembly. Continuous 1x timing deferred to creator review.

gripAndVisualEvaluation.gloveOcclusion: Axe haft passes under glove naturally; fingers grip haft securely in hoist, apex, downward swing, and ground impact
gripAndVisualEvaluation.palmWristContinuity: handFront aligns precisely with the underlying body arm; no floating stamp artifacts
gripAndVisualEvaluation.weaponVisibility: Axe visible only during active interval [2..8]; hidden in frames 0, 1, 9, 10, 11
gripAndVisualEvaluation.tacticalReadability: Distinct visual separation of axe blade, body armor, and limbs at game scale

grip-specialist/front_l-Axe-full.safeSuggestions: Ready for candidate matrix patch assembly. Continuous 1x timing deferred to creator review.
